name: CollQueryFlags
meaning: u8 flag byte passed to Collide_SweepBox / Collide_SweepBox_Sam / Coll_BoxGroundQuery

name: CQ_STATIC_EXT
meaning: also enables static triangles, plus the id-list-7 exclusion zones and id-list-6 static boxes prepass (Collide_SweepBox only)

name: CQ_OBJECTS
meaning: test scenaric objects from the object grid

name: CQ_SAM_WALL_OVERLAP
meaning: Sam sweep only: triangles with |normal.y|<2000 are plain overlap-tested, frac forced 0, result bit 0x8000

name: CQ_ASK_MOVER
meaning: mover->HandleMessage(NULL, 0x77, candidate) nonzero vetoes the candidate

name: CQ_IGNORE_SKIPBOX
meaning: test generic boxes even when obj flag 0x400 is set

name: CQ_FROM_GROUND_QUERY
meaning: ORed in by Coll_BoxGroundQuery when calling a custom collider

name: CQ_FROM_QUERY_GROUND_Y
meaning: passed only by ScnObject::QueryGroundY (w.mode | 0x80); never tested (verified)
